1. Engagement Scope

The scope of this review is limited to an assessment of Council on Urban Mobility's compliance with New Jersey Diane B. Allen Equal Pay Act; SEC Rule 14a-8 (shareholder proposals); COBRA §601 (continuation of health coverage). The analysis covers the period from 2015-08-14 to 2015-10-28 and includes a sample of 61 employee records from the Community Foundations business unit. Findings are intended for internal management use only.

2. Methodology

The methodology for this review was aligned with the PCAOB auditing standards for an audit of internal control over financial reporting. Testing included design effectiveness assessments and operating effectiveness testing for 61 key controls.

4. Detailed Findings
CRP-8196-001LOWMONITORING
Observation

OFCCP Directive 2022-01 pay equity audit not conducted for the 2015 affirmative action plan cycle

Corrective Action Required

The designated management official at each of the 24 establishments shall personally certify the OSHA 300A summary by the February 1st deadline annually.

Management Response

We concur with the finding. The process has been redesigned, and user acceptance testing is scheduled for the week of 2015-08-14. Full implementation will follow immediately after successful testing.

Owner: Associate, Policy & Government Relations • Due: 2015-12-28
CRP-5250-002INFORMATIONALDEFERRED
Observation

PCAOB Auditing Standard No. 18 requires disclosure of related party transactions not found in the 2015 10-K

Corrective Action Required

All severance and release agreements for employees aged 40 and over must be reviewed by legal counsel to ensure compliance with all OWBPA requirements, including consideration periods.

Management Response

We concur with the finding. The process has been redesigned, and user acceptance testing is scheduled for the week of 2015-08-14. Full implementation will follow immediately after successful testing.

Owner: Associate, Policy & Government Relations • Due: 2015-09-28
CRP-4986-003LOWMONITORING
Observation

WARN Act notification timeline not met for 61 affected employees in 24 reduction-in-force

Corrective Action Required

Conduct a self-audit of all I-9 forms for employees hired in the past 12 months. Correct all identified errors and provide remedial training to all staff responsible for I-9 verification.

Management Response

This finding has been remediated as of the report date. Supporting documentation, including revised policy language and employee acknowledgment records, has been provided to ACPWB under separate cover. Council on Urban Mobility requests formal closure of this item.

Owner: Director of Public Relations • Due: 2015-09-28
CRP-2890-004LOWOPEN
Observation

Final pay for 61 terminated employees in California not provided within the statutory timeframe

Corrective Action Required

The Compensation Committee shall convene a special meeting to review the identified financial restatement and initiate clawback procedures for all applicable executive incentive compensation.

Management Response

This finding has been remediated as of the report date. Supporting documentation, including revised policy language and employee acknowledgment records, has been provided to ACPWB under separate cover. Council on Urban Mobility requests formal closure of this item.
